## AI

### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 7/10" aria-label="Importance 7 of 10">7</span> Anthropic expands Claude Startup program with free Team tier and credits
Anthropic expanded its Claude Startup program to provide free Team tier access for one year and $1,000 in credits per startup. The company also offers free or discounted Claude subscriptions to scientists and up to $50,000 in credits through its AI for Science program.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Free Team tier for 1 year to startups, plus $1,000 credits per startup</li>
<li>Up to 10,000 free scientist seats offered; premium at $15/month</li>
<li>Up to $50,000 credits per project through AI for Science program</li>
</ul>

### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 7/10" aria-label="Importance 7 of 10">7</span> Claude integration now available in public beta across Google Workspace
Anthropic launched Claude as an add-on for Google Workspace in public beta on October 6, 2026, available to all paid Claude plan subscribers. The integration enables Claude to perform tasks directly within Workspace applications, including editing in Docs.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Claude for Google Workspace launched October 6, 2026 in public beta</li>
<li>Available to all paid Claude plan subscribers</li>
<li>Claude can edit Docs without altering surrounding formatting</li>
</ul>
